name: lever belt romanian deadlift (v bar)
description: A belt-loaded lever machine Romanian deadlift using a V bar for a neutral grip. It targets the hamstrings and glutes with a comfortable hand position.
instructions: Step into the machine, secure the belt and take the V bar with both hands.
Stand tall with soft knees and your shoulders back.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back as the bar slides down your thighs.
Lower until your hamstrings are well stretched, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward and stand up straight.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
